title: Artifact Manifest
description: Metadata record for a generated artifact, tracking its source, format, output path, validation status, and dependencies. Every artifact operation produces or updates a manifest entry for traceability.

title.description: Document title as it appears in the artifact

source_artifact.description: Artifact ID of the source if this artifact was produced by conversion or export from another artifact

source_format.description: Format of the source artifact, if applicable

output_path.description: Absolute file path where the artifact was written

generation_method.description: How the artifact was produced: create=new file, update=modified existing, export=converted from another format, compile=built from source (e.g. LaTeX to PDF), normalize=formatting normalization applied

validation_status.description: Result of artifact validation: valid=file exists, opens, and parses correctly; invalid=validation failed (see validation_errors); not-validated=validation not yet run

validation_errors.description: List of validation errors if validation_status is invalid

export_status.description: Export delivery status: pending=awaiting export, exported=successfully delivered, failed=export failed (artifact may be in fallback format), not-applicable=no export step required

file_size_bytes.description: File size of the generated artifact in bytes

word_count.description: Approximate word count of the document content

dependencies_used.description: Tools, templates, libraries, or MCP servers used in artifact generation (e.g. 'artifact-server', 'pandoc', 'latex-template-default')

run_id.description: Cache run ID this artifact belongs to

created_by.description: Agent ID that produced this artifact

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent update to the artifact or its manifest entry
